environment: Synthetic private workflow fixture only; no real human adjudications
validated_behaviors: Only a third adjudicator can decide a case with two distinct frozen-content human reviews.
A decision must follow both reviews in time and contain a relevance label and reason.
A batch is bound to exact source manifest and case hashes and creates a new private dataset version.
Undecided cases retain their prior state; one decided fixture case does not make the dataset publishable gold.
A stale batch, repeat reviewer or incomplete review trace fails before output publication.
limitations: Fixture identities and decisions are synthetic and do not represent real people or reviewed news.
The code cannot prove human identity, true independence or that frozen source content was actually read.
Only relevance adjudication is supported here; event, tone and impact judgments need separate task contracts.
No model-quality or production-readiness claim is supported.
